description: This file manages model selection and configuration within a larger AI/ML project, including prompting users for model choices, handling provider authentication, and applying model allowlists and fallbacks.

methods.name: loadModelPickerRuntime
methods.description: Dynamically imports the model picker runtime module.

methods.name: hasAuthForProvider
methods.description: Checks if there is authentication available for a given provider.

methods.name: createProviderAuthChecker
methods.description: Creates a function to check provider authentication status with caching.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredModelRaw
methods.description: Resolves the raw configured model from the config.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredModelKeys
methods.description: Gets the list of configured model keys.

methods.name: normalizeModelKeys
methods.description: Normalizes a list of model keys, removing duplicates and trimming.

methods.name: addModelSelectOption
methods.description: Adds a model option to the selection list with hints.

methods.name: matchesPreferredProvider
methods.description: Checks if a provider matches the preferred provider criteria.

methods.name: promptManualModel
methods.description: Prompts user to manually input a model.

methods.name: buildModelProviderFilterOptions
methods.description: Builds filter options for providers based on model count.

methods.name: maybeFilterModelsByProvider
methods.description: Filters models based on provider preference and user prompt.

methods.name: resolveProviderPluginSetupOptions
methods.description: Resolves setup options for provider plugins.

methods.name: maybeHandleProviderPluginSelection
methods.description: Handles selection and authentication of provider plugins.

methods.name: promptDefaultModel
methods.description: Main function to prompt user for default model selection.

methods.name: promptModelAllowlist
methods.description: Prompts user to set or modify model allowlist.

methods.name: applyModelAllowlist
methods.description: Applies a list of models as an allowlist in the config.

methods.name: applyModelFallbacksFromSelection
methods.description: Sets fallback models based on user selection.
